dedupe_keys.name: netzgrafik editor regular interval timetable design and analysis sbb

description: Netzgrafik-Editor is open-source software from SBB for creating, modifying and analysing regular-interval (clock-face) timetables. The README states the aim of accelerating the planning and sizing of transport systems through an intuitive platform with projections and analyses, so that timetable variants and service options can be created, compared and optimised. It offers a flexible level of detail from rough sketch to detailed plan, applies to bus, train and plane, scales from hobby to professional use, digitalises a previously paper-driven process and runs analyses in real time; its key feature is an interactive graphical editor for the network graphic. Coverage: any network. Format and access: web application source code. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0, free. Caveats: a design tool, not a simulator of operations; the backend is in a separate repository. It supports capacity planning and optimisation of timetable concepts. It relates to the RCM-DX format from the same railway and PTV Lines in the catalogue.
inputs: Lines, stops and regular-interval timetable patterns drawn by the user
name: Netzgrafik-Editor: regular-interval timetable design and analysis (SBB)
outputs: Regular-interval timetable network graphics with real-time analyses
